notes.title: Survivorman VR: The Descent is out now!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce our survival adventure sim [b]Suvivorman VR: the Descent[/b] 
is out today!

You can now test your own mountaintop survival skills without having to freeze to death!
You’ll learn real-life survival tips as you explore, craft, hunt, while being coached by legendary survival expert Les Stroud. Combine your skills and Les's advice to escape from the treacherous Arctic mountaintop alive!

It's been a wild ride, and we'd like to thank everyone who has helped on the game including our publishing partners at VRKiwi, who optimized our Quest for PS VR2 and PCVR. We'd also like to do a shout out to our fans across the globe who have stepped up to do play testing for us on these, you have been truly amazing in providing your feedback!

Give it a spin, and let us know what you think!

This Friday we will be doing a live AMA on Reddit, where the dev team and Les Stroud will answer all your questions about survival, and the game. Don't miss it!
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PSVR/comments/1aqp50n/friday_feb_16_live_ama_with_les_stroud_and_the/]Link to Reddit AMA.[/url]

-the Survivorman VR Team

notes.title: Survivorman VR The Descent releases on February 15
notes.notes:
Hey Survivalists! 


Quick flashback to 2023 and a sneak peek at what's coming this year – we're coming to PS VR2 and PCVR, folks!


October 18th, Survivorman VR dropped on the Meta Quest 2 and 3. The reviews so far have been awesome, holding a cool 80-84% rating! Your feedback has been so encouraging - hearing how you dug the real-deal survival tips from Les Stroud and how our game stands out from the usual VR games made our day. Survivorman VR is all about authentic survival, putting you right in the thick of real-life challenges.

Prepare to learn some serious survival skills, and who knows, they might save your life one day! 


[previewyoutube=ZaNXjM5BapE;full][/previewyoutube]

This February is going to be busy – we're launching on PCVR and PS VR2 with slicker graphics, smoother performance, and some cool new features. And hey, Quest crew, we've got you covered with an update that includes a secret new level... Ice Tunnels! Go on, try to track it down!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43123528/bf4b9494d108052fd7816f264341a60a65ee20a7.gif[/img]


Creating this game has been a wild ride, we loved throwing you some serious challenges while packing it with fun treats (who's spotted all the granola bars? Or the secret extra Les performance?). Can't wait to hear your thoughts!


Keep your eyes peeled for more updates and jump into our discord: https://discord.com/invite/4TcqKmQs7V


Catch you soon!
